title.zh: 全球金融稳定委员会警告稳定币跨境风险，呼吁制定危机应对机制
title.en: 全球金融稳定委员会警告稳定币跨境风险，呼吁制定危机应对机制

current_state.zh: The Financial Stability Board warned that stablecoins remain untested under severe stress and called for stronger cross-border information sharing, risk monitoring, and pre-planned crisis-resolution mechanisms for failing issuers, highlighting multi-issuer reserve fragmentation and 24/7 redemption risks ahead of the Oct 15 G20 finance ministers' meeting.
